title: Andhra Pradesh Ranks 2nd Nationally in MISHTI Mangrove Restoration
summary: Secures 2nd rank in mangrove plantation area under Shoreline Habitats initiative behind Gujarat.

blocks.content: Secures 2nd rank in mangrove plantation area under Shoreline Habitats initiative behind Gujarat.

items: State Rankings: Gujarat ranks 1st in total plantation area; Andhra Pradesh 2nd.
MISHTI Scheme: Launched June 5, 2023 for 540 sq. km. mangrove restoration across 9 states and 4 UTs.
National Cover: West Bengal holds 42.45% of national mangrove cover (Sundarbans).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Sundarbans is the world's largest contiguous mangrove forest (UNESCO World Heritage Site).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: 1st rank mangrove plantation (Gujarat) vs largest national mangrove cover share (West Bengal, 42.45%).
